new_blockers.what: NOTE-level — the new disclosure overstates in one defensive arm. `recentSuccessListBasis` renders whenever the recent-success count is > 0 (client-work-attention.tsx:163-165), but when the pack's window cannot be read, `workAttentionHref` deliberately drops both dates and opens a bare `?status=completed` (client-work-pack.ts:281-288, pinned by client-work-pack.test.ts:247-254 "an unreadable window drops the dates rather than guessing them"). Defensive-only path (the door always returns a window), so this is polish, not a defect the ticket promises to avoid.
